title: Grain drying and safe storage guide
context: Smallholder farmers lose a large share of cereal harvests to poor drying and storage. FAO and other bodies publish established good practice, but not in one short, plain-language, openly-licensed guide.
objective: Write a concise, plain-language guide to drying grain to a safe moisture level and storing it to minimize loss and pest damage, summarizing established practice from authoritative open sources.
acceptanceCriteria: Sections: why it matters, drying to safe moisture, choosing/preparing storage, preventing pests and mold, common mistakes
Written for non-specialists at roughly an 8th-grade reading level
Cites at least 2 authoritative open sources (e.g. FAO) with links
Stays within established general practice; gives no farm-specific or chemical-dosing advice
Includes a CC-BY-4.0 license header and source attributions
